provenance.source: curated subset of the vibecheck_v1 checklist for a non-technical owner go/no-go review (sample second framework)
provenance.method: hand-reviewed mapping onto existing stable control IDs; reuse is intentional and pinned by tests (no control record is duplicated)
provenance.change_policy: sample only: illustrates control reuse across frameworks; not a compliance framework.

wording.tech_en: Primary data store is a managed persistent DB; no SQLite/JSON-file/localStorage as system of record.
wording.tech_et: Põhihoidla on hallatud püsiv andmebaas; mitte SQLite/JSON-fail/localStorage põhihoidlana.
wording.plain_en: Is user data stored in a durable database, not a file or browser storage?
wording.plain_et: Kas kasutajaandmed on püsivas andmebaasis, mitte failis või brauseri mälus?
wording.test_en: Ask where data lives; the scanner flags SQLite/JSON-file/localStorage on ephemeral hosting.
wording.test_et: Küsi, kus andmed elavad; skanner märgib SQLite/JSON-faili ajutisel majutusel.

verification.tools: storage question, second pair of eyes

provenance.rationale: founder item 1 reuses vibecheck.control.arch.datastore_fit without duplicating any control

wording.tech_en: Object-level authorization and tenant isolation hold against a second account.
wording.tech_et: Objektitaseme õigused ja rentniku eraldus peavad vastu teisele kontole.
wording.plain_en: Could another customer see or change data that is not theirs?
wording.plain_et: Kas keegi teine saaks näha või muuta andmed, mis ei ole tema omad?
wording.test_en: Two test accounts; try to read/write the other account's records.
wording.test_et: Kaks testkontot; proovi teise konto kirjeid lugeda või muuta.

provenance.rationale: founder item 2 reuses vibecheck.control.authz.object_level, vibecheck.control.authz.tenant_isolation without duplicating any control

wording.tech_en: Authentication and handling of credentials use a proven provider/library, never hand-rolled crypto.
wording.tech_et: Autentimine ja mandaadid kasutavad tõestatud teenust/teeki, mitte isetehtud krüptot.
wording.plain_en: Are login and secrets handled by a proven provider or library?
wording.plain_et: Kas sisselogimist ja saladusi haldab tõestatud teenus või teek?
wording.test_en: Ask which auth provider handles login; the scanner flags home-made primitives.
wording.test_et: Küsi, milline teenus sisselogimist haldab; skanner märgib isetehtud räsid.

provenance.rationale: founder item 3 reuses vibecheck.control.arch.proven_auth_provider, vibecheck.control.privacy.password_hashing without duplicating any control

wording.tech_en: Dependencies and the supply chain are reviewed for vulnerabilities and trust.
wording.tech_et: Sõltuvused ja tarneahel on üle vaadatud haavatavuste ja usalduse osas.
wording.plain_en: Are the libraries and packages the app is built on reviewed?
wording.plain_et: Kas raamatukogud ja paketid, millel rakendus põhineb, on üle vaadatud?
wording.test_en: Run a lockfile scan (OSV/Trivy) in CI and evaluate severity and reachability.
wording.test_et: Käivita lukufaili skann (OSV/Trivy) ning hinda haavatavusi ja nende mõju.

provenance.rationale: founder item 6 reuses vibecheck.control.deps.dependency_trust, vibecheck.control.deps.vuln_scanning without duplicating any control

wording.tech_en: Versioned migrations, tested backups and safe production-change control are demonstrable.
wording.tech_et: Versioonitud migratsioonid, testitud varukoopiad ja ohutu tootemuudatuste kontroll on tõendatud.
wording.plain_en: Can you restore your data after a bad deployment or deletion?
wording.plain_et: Kas saad pärast vigast juurutust või kustutamist andmed taastada?
wording.test_en: Do a backup restore drill on a throwaway environment.

provenance.rationale: founder item 7 reuses vibecheck.control.data.versioned_migrations, vibecheck.control.data.tested_backups, vibecheck.control.deploy.change_control without duplicating any control

wording.tech_en: Account ownership, data export and failure recovery are available and tested.
wording.tech_et: Kontode omanik, andmete eksport ja rikkest taastumine on saadaval ja testitud.
wording.plain_en: Can you get your users' data back out, and recover accounts if needed?
wording.plain_et: Kas saad kasutajate andmed välja ja vigased kontod taastada?
wording.test_en: Walk through export and account recovery with a real second user.
wording.test_et: Käi eksport ja konto taastamine läbi teise reaalse kasutajaga.

provenance.rationale: founder item 8 reuses vibecheck.control.continuity.account_ownership, vibecheck.control.continuity.data_export, vibecheck.control.continuity.failure_recovery without duplicating any control
